limitations: Diagnostic simulation only, produced by an explicitly non-eligible execution path. The authoritative sequential engine and frozen financial rules are applied to real structurally-valid literal-USD history using explicit test-convention profiles, so these are not broker-approved executions. No research eligibility, calendar/profile/licensing approval, scientific validity or qualification is granted. Non-USD-quote instruments and eligibility-bearing data classes are refused by the engine. Money figures and counts are observations, not performance evidence. The cache is a local resumption aid: a hit is only possible when corpus identity, month, chunk inventory, strategy, costs, budgets and engine version are identical.
